title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 06 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 06 March 2026. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura, and Kaluthara districts during evening or night. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Northern, North-central, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva and North-western provinces during the early hours of the morning.
